text:
Anders Lee spent 923 games with the Islanders and is now a Utah Mammoth at 36, and the early returns are better than his line says. He has three goals and ten points in 24 games, no goals in his last 12, but Utah takes 62% of the five-on-five expected goals with him on (expected goals measure the quality of chances), eight points better than without him, and he has 7.5 expected goals on his own shots.

So this is a finishing slump with the process intact: three goals on 7.5 expected, and the team has scored five fewer goals than its chances with him on the ice. Evolving-Hockey had him in the 99th percentile among forwards for driving play last season, and Corey Sznajder's All Three Zones tracking still has him in the 91st percentile for chances in front of the net, with 20% of his setups coming from behind the goal line. He won the King Clancy in 2023-24. A sixth-round pick with 308 career goals knows how to wait out a cold stretch. Our range has him around 17 goals.
